page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core processing, measured via stress-ng and Geekbench, falls into the lower performance tier, with single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression showing weak to poor results. Conversely, multi-core operations, including multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests, consistently achieve average tier performance. Memory bandwidth tests also demonstrate average throughput for both cached and uncached read/write operations, though the overall Passmark memory score is weak.

Given its hardware profile, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that scale horizontally across its 32 dedicated cores rather than those requiring high single-thread performance. It is suited for multi-threaded applications such as static web serving, database operations, and moderate LLM inference tasks using small to medium models. It is less suitable for single-threaded processing or workloads requiring high-speed local storage.
